title: NFL Pool
description: An NFL application that allows you to create a NFL pool with your friends and family to see who can correctly guess the winner of each game. How this works is you create a pool, invite your friends to join, and then each week you can submit your guesses for each game along with confidence points. At the end of each week, the person with the highest confidence score wins that week. After every quarter in the season, the person with the highest score wins the pool for that quarter. Tie-breakers come into play if there is a tie at the end of that quarter. The final quarter is the Playoffs. The person with the highest score after the Playoffs wins the pool. The person with the highest score overall wins the pool for the season.

title: BitByBit
description: A full-stack platform for learning embedded systems and low-level programming through structured lessons, quizzes, and code walkthroughs.

title: ESP Home Automation
description: This ESPHome application manages a smart garage door opener with features like auto-closing, virtual locking, and real-time logging to a NAS server. It monitors door state through sensors, controls a relay for door operation, and logs events like door openings, closings, and errors. It also integrates with Home Assistant for remote management and supports secure Wi-Fi, OTA updates, and web-based monitoring.

title: Home Deal Finder
description: Looking for homes and organizing them in an excel document hasn't become more easier with this browser extension. This tool allows you to visit Zillow, Redfin, and Trulia, and gather the information (Address, Selling Price, Rooms and Square Footage) to place into an excel sheet and have your way with the data of the home.
